stage0021_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Kalinin
「...I am Major $$アンドレイ・セルゲイヴィッチ・カリーニン$$,
　dispatched from the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$
　to explain this operation.」

stage0021_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Also, I will command this operation: Black $$バトリング$$.」

stage0021_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ルカ$$
（As expected of a $$ミスリル$$ commander.
　He looks every bit the battle veteran.）

stage0021_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（True.
　This makes me expect great things
　from the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s captain too.）

stage0021_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルト$$
（The captain says even Captain $$ジェフリー$$
　thinks highly of him.）

stage0021_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$クルツ$$
（That's what the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ rookies are saying, Boss.）

stage0021_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マオ$$
（Young... way too young.
　This makes me look forward to meeting them.）

stage0021_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$クルツ$$
（That $$ミシェル$$...
　he'll get more of a shock than he expects.）

stage0021_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$クルツ$$
（Whoops, looks like our little secret got overheard.）

stage0021_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Now then, let me outline Black $$バトリング$$.
　The operation site is $$ア・コバ$$, Mexico.」

stage0021_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Do you know it, Sergeant Sagara?」

stage0021_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sir!
　A weapons dealer I am acquainted with
　is currently active in that area.」

stage0021_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just hearing there's a weapons dealer there
　tells me how bad this place is.」

stage0021_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Underground $$バトリング$$ is held in $$ア・コバ$$,
　and it funds the mafia and terrorists.」

stage0021_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$バトリング$$ is when robots fight
　with money wagered on them, right...」

stage0021_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It began with people of 《$$アストラギウス$$》 sent to $$ＡＤＷ$$,
　joined by pilots pushed out of the military.」

stage0021_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Now it has been refined into more of a sport,
　run as a state sanctioned gambling business.」

stage0021_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's a joke, honestly.
　It's basically pro wrestling, they've even
　got masked AT pilots.」

stage0021_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Most people enjoy its clean operation now,
　but some still long for $$バトリング$$'s darker roots.」

stage0021_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マオ$$
「That underground atmosphere... insane stakes...
　and above all, the razor's edge thrill of
　wagering your life for real. That's the gist.」

stage0021_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Because of people like that, unlicensed
　underground $$バトリング$$ still goes on today
　in unruly towns beyond Federation forces' reach.」

stage0021_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$ア・コバ$$, Namsak in Southeast Asia,
　South America, the old Shinjuku Ghetto, and so on.」

stage0021_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アルト$$
（I heard $$キリコ$$ used to fight in $$バトリング$$
　back in that old Shinjuku Ghetto too.）

stage0021_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
（If someone that skilled took part,
　this is no mere fallback for washed up soldiers.）

stage0021_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Question time!
　We hear rumors of underground $$バトリング$$
　all over, so why head to $$ア・コバ$$?」

stage0021_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Most $$バトリング$$ funds the mafia, true,
　but it is also an outlet for oppressed people.」

stage0021_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$ミスリル$$ judges it a necessary evil, and so
　has no intention of stamping it all out.」

stage0021_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「But $$ア・コバ$$ is a case we cannot overlook.」

stage0021_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「We suspect a large scale organization
　stands behind $$ア・コバ$$'s underground $$バトリング$$.」

stage0021_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「And we believe that organization uses $$バトリング$$
　to test new weapons and train soldiers.」

stage0021_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So $$ミスリル$$ sees an organization capable
　of that much as a genuine threat?」

stage0021_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That is correct.
　The terrorists who struck Tokyo and dragged
　in Hanka too may answer to that same group.」

stage0021_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$クラン$$
「I see...
　This is not something we can ignore.」

stage0021_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「The operation's first stage begins with
　infiltrating $$ア・コバ$$ to investigate the
　reality of its underground $$バトリング$$.」

stage0021_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Depending on circumstances, we may also
　ask Sergeant Sagara's contact for help.」

stage0021_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$宗介$$'s contact, huh...
　I've got that same bad feeling as always...」

stage0021_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$n
「It'll probably be fine.
　The battlefield's his home turf, after all.」

stage0021_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
Spectator
「Get him, right there!
　Kill it!!」

stage0021_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
Spectator
「What are you doing, you clown!
　Where the hell are your eyes!」

stage0021_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
Spectator
「Rank amateur!
　Dodge a stray shot, at least!」

stage0021_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
Spectator
「Man, this is the best!
　The thrill of $$リアルバトル$$, you know!」

stage0021_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「T-this place is even wilder than the rumors...」

stage0021_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「That's why I said it'd be better
　to stay on the Quarter.」

stage0021_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I am $n's partner.
　If you go, it's only right that I go too.」

stage0021_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Anyway, just to meet one of $$宗介$$'s
　contacts, why did $n want to come along?」

stage0021_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you have an interest in $$バトリング$$?」

stage0021_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$宗介$$
「Knowing you,
　you probably mean to train yourself here...」

stage0021_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$キリコ$$
「This is not some place that soft.」

stage0021_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$n
「I think I know that much without being told.」

stage0021_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's enough, $$キリコ$$, $n.
　I didn't bring you two here to fight.」

stage0021_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Still, I'm surprised, $$キリコ$$.
　Didn't peg you for the type to meddle.」

stage0021_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Ain't no harm in it.
　If $n wants to do it,
　just let them.」

stage0021_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$クルツ$$
「This one's got their own reasons
　for fighting, after all.」

stage0021_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$n's reason for fighting...
　Sure, there's protecting peace from
　terrorists and invaders, but...）

stage0021_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スズネ$$
（But I don't see what's beyond that...
　What is $n trying to grow stronger
　in order to fight...）

stage0021_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Chat time is over.
　The person we're meeting has arrived.」

stage0021_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　It really is $$キリコ$$!!」

stage0021_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ゴウト$$...
　And $$バニラ$$ and $$ココナ$$ too...」

stage0021_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Ha ha, $$キリコ$$!
　Give us a heads up before coming to $$ア・コバ$$, you!」

stage0021_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Don't be unreasonable, $$バニラ$$!
　We've only been here a week ourselves!」

stage0021_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Oh, right, right.
　We told our regular customers for now,
　meant to tell $$キリコ$$ once things settled.」

stage0021_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$宗介$$...
　So $$ゴウト$$ was the contact you meant.」

stage0021_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's right.
　He does me various favors.」

stage0021_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「You bet.
　No run of the mill weapons dealer could
　ever meet the demands you make.」

stage0021_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Just the other day you had me gather
　human sized power assist gear and
　electronics. Building a man sized AS?」

stage0021_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Classified.
　I can't discuss that yet.」

stage0021_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$n
（...I just hope you keep that classified forever...）

stage0021_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$スズネ$$
（...To protect the children's dreams, too...）

stage0021_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$バニラ$$
「But this is a surprise.
　Who knew $$キリコ$$ and $$宗介$$ knew each other.」

stage0021_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ココナ$$
「So that means $$宗介$$
　is in the mercenary unit that scouted $$キリコ$$.」

stage0021_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Same here, I'm surprised.
　Who knew $$宗介$$'s acquaintances were you guys.」

stage0021_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So you all knew
　these people as well, $$クルツ$$?」

stage0021_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, yeah.
　I mean, these guys are
　self-proclaimed managers of $$キリコ$$'s.」

stage0021_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「When $$ミスリル$$ scouted $$キリコ$$,
　they really jacked up the price on us too.」

stage0021_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Turned out to be a bargain, didn't it?」

stage0021_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well then, intros for the new faces.」

stage0021_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
Gotho
「I'm $$ブールーズ・ゴウト$$.
　From arms dealing to matchmaking in $$バトリング$$,
　I'm sort of a jack-of-all-trades.」

stage0021_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
Vanilla
「I'm $$バニラ・バートラー$$.
　Business partner to old man $$ゴウト$$ here.」

stage0021_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ココナ$$
「I'm $$ココナ$$.
　Just a small-time info broker these days,
　but I used to be a club's singing star.」

stage0021_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「So, $$宗介$$...
　you've got something you want to ask us?」

stage0021_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$マオ$$
「I'll ask on $$宗介$$'s behalf for that part.」

stage0021_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Long time no see, Boss $$マオ$$.
　Still as gorgeous as ever, huh.」

stage0021_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Va-ni-lla!
　Keep making eyes like that
　and they'll pluck you clean again.」

stage0021_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$マオ$$
「Relax.
　All we want to buy from you this time is info.」

stage0021_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$マオ$$
「You said you'd been in $$ア・コバ$$
　for a week now...
　So why come to this city?」

stage0021_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Obviously, we caught wind of the underground $$バトリング$$.
　Run something this big,
　and it draws serious money and people.」

stage0021_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Where there's that, there's a deal or two...
　and we figured a big one was lying around.」

stage0021_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... that's a reason that sounds just like you.」

stage0021_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...$$マオ$$, questioning $$ゴウト$$ alone should do.
　I'm borrowing $$バニラ$$.」

stage0021_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Sure thing!
　I brought $$フィアナ$$ along properly, too.」

stage0021_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「$$キリコ$$...!
　Why are you here...」

stage0021_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Like you can see, that's $$キリコ$$'s thing.」

stage0021_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... so even $$キリコ$$
　makes that face in front of someone precious.」

stage0021_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$n
「But that $$フィアナ$$ person...
　she looks unwell...」

stage0021_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Yeah...
　The situation isn't great.」

stage0021_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
Shako
「$$ル・シャッコ$$.
　I'm from $$クエント$$.」

stage0021_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$クエント$$... one of the planets of the 《$$ネオ・プラネッツ$$》.」

stage0021_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
「I've heard the Quentians there are big,
　and the men go abroad as mercenaries.」

stage0021_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$バニラ$$
「That's the gist of it.
　$$シャッコ$$ met $$キリコ$$ on a job as a mercenary,
　and now he's one of our family.」

stage0021_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$キリコ$$ told me to stay.
　Said to protect her...」

stage0021_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ココナ$$
「$$フィアナ$$'s been unwell for a long time.
　We've had all kinds of doctors look at her,
　but nobody knows what's causing it...」

stage0021_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Seeing a doctor costs money...
　and a special one costs a fortune, so...
　$$キリコ$$ took $$ミスリル$$'s scouting offer.」

stage0021_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$バニラ$$
「$$ア・コバ$$'s where
　$$アストラギウス$$'s ne'er-do-wells all gather.
　Hoping we find some clue to her illness here...」

stage0021_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Rest now, $$フィアナ$$.
　It's bad for your body.」

stage0021_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't worry about anything.
　I'll deal with your condition somehow.」

stage0021_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Listening to $$フィアナ$$'s weakening heartbeat,
　I cursed my own powerlessness...」

stage0021_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I go on living in war, unchanged,
　while $$フィアナ$$ isn't even allowed to live...」

stage0021_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$バトリング$$...
　The dogs that flock to this life-or-death game
　born of $$アストラギウス$$...」

stage0021_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$キリコ$$
「There must be a key to saving $$フィアナ$$ there...」

stage0021_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn... that $$キリコ$$...!
　Infuriating as ever!」

stage0021_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I told you, $$カン・ユー$$.
　If someone worth fighting shows up,
　report it to me.」

stage0021_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Forgotten the debt for me picking you up?
　Or do you want me to kill you?」

stage0021_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「N-no, Lord $$ニーバ$$!
　This time's opponent wasn't someone worth
　troubling you over, Lord $$ニーバ$$...」

stage0021_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Quite the mouth on you, after such a mess.」

stage0021_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「F-forgive me!
　Please forgive me!
　If you keep choking me like this, I'll...!」

stage0021_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Then answer me.
　The man you were targeting...」

stage0021_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「He's $$レッドショルダー$$, isn't he?」

stage0021_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you mean the one I was pursuing,
　you're talking about $$キリコ$$?」

stage0021_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-yes!
　That man, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$,
　is a former $$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0021_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「It's finally here...
　This day at last...」

stage0021_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Wait for me, $$レッドショルダー$$...
　I'll strangle you dead with these hands...!」

stage0021_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Not bad, $$キリコ$$!
　Thanks to you, all of $$ア・コバ$$'s caught fire!」

stage0021_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Yo, walking powder keg!
　A broken needle bound for the heart, a dangerous dud!」

stage0021_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But the organization behind the underground
　battling remains unknown」

stage0021_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$マオ$$
「A Balarant unaffiliated with the Federation,
　holding that much firepower, no less...」

stage0021_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But what I can't understand
　is why they refused to join the Federation.」

stage0021_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Major $$オズマ$$'s got a fair point there.
　After all, the current government claims
　equal treatment for transferees too.」

stage0021_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$マオ$$
「Unlike Earth supremacists oppressing Spacenoids,
　I haven't heard of $$アストラギウス$$ natives facing
　discrimination within the military.」

stage0021_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「So basically, those Balarant folks
　kicked away a stable life to become outlaws?」

stage0021_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Well... we ain't one to judge,
　but there's misfits everywhere.
　Guess they're no different?」

stage0021_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$オズマ$$
「If only it were that simple...」

stage0021_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$バニラ$$
「No need to worry, Major.
　$$キリコ$$'s group already laid the bait today.」

stage0021_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Now we just track whoever bites on it,
　and the mastermind will show up soon enough.」

stage0021_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「In fact, a matchmaker's
　coming here again today.」

stage0021_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So that means a $$バトリング$$ match is being set up?」

stage0021_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「That's right.
　And I won't take some cheap little match.
　After all, we've got a top-class fighter here.」

stage0021_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$マオ$$
「Could it be, old man...
　you're planning to use $$キリコ$$ and us
　to make yourself a quick buck?」

stage0021_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well, I won't deny it.
　That kind of give-and-take relationship
　is easier on both of us, ain't it?」

stage0021_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Fine.
　I'll square things myself with
　Major $$カリーニン$$ and Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

stage0021_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$オズマ$$
「When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
　We'll play by your rules here.」

stage0021_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Now you're talking, Major.
　Hearing that gets me all fired up.」

stage0021_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「...Coming through.
　Name's $$チェロキー$$, I'm a matchmaker.」

stage0021_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Been waiting for you, $$チェロキー$$.」

stage0021_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Ha ha ha! Long time no see, $$ゴウト$$!」

stage0021_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What, so this matchmaker guy is
　an old buddy of the old man's!?」

stage0021_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Yeah.
　He's an old work buddy of mine.」

stage0021_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「And even back then, the one who fussed most
　over money was this guy, $$ゴウト$$.」

stage0021_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「The hell you say!
　I wouldn't dare call myself number one over you!」

stage0021_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$マオ$$
（So basically, they're two of a kind.）

stage0021_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「The one in the pressure suit, riding a Scopedog?」

stage0021_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「That's right.
　He's the genuine article, an ex-$$レッドショルダー$$.」

stage0021_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「What good would lying to an old pal do?」

stage0021_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Let me tell you, it ain't just $$レッドショルダー$$s.
　We've got $$クエント$$ folk, space outlaw gangs,
　and thugs kicked out of the regular army too.」

stage0021_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$マオ$$
（Hold it in, Major.
　This is just talk to rile people up.）

stage0021_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$バニラ$$
（If you've got a complaint, tell yourself.
　It was you, Major, who said we'd go along
　with the old man's way of doing things.）

stage0021_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Not bad, $$ゴウト$$.
　You sure rounded up quite a lineup.」

stage0021_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Right?
　So do me a favor, $$チェロキー$$.
　Put together a card worthy of this lineup.」

stage0021_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「You got it, leave it to me!」

stage0021_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Now, about the pay.
　...let's talk that over in the back, slowly.」

stage0021_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Understood.
　Sounds like this'll be a long talk.」

stage0021_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Knowing those two,
　they're probably scheming over how much cash
　they can stuff into their own pockets.」

stage0021_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But this moves the operation to its next stage.
　Now it's just a matter of how much prey
　takes the bait we've laid out.」

stage0021_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But I'm reminded of it all over again...
　how when he moves, the whole scene moves too.」

stage0021_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ココナ$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　Is $$キリコ$$ around!?」

stage0021_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$バニラ$$
「What's up, $$ココナ$$?
　$$キリコ$$'s right here sleeping, but...」

stage0021_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ココナ$$
「I got my hands on some prime intel!」

stage0021_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ココナ$$
「The Federation forces are in town,
　and word is, they're looking for $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0021_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ココナ$$
「And get this, they used to be Gilgamesh!
　No matter how you look at it, they know
　$$フィアナ$$'s a $$ＰＳ$$ and they're hunting her for it!」

stage0021_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$マオ$$
「I saw it in the files.
　People engineered for war by Gilgamesh forces...」

stage0021_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　And $$フィアナ$$ is one of those $$ＰＳ$$.」

stage0021_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ココナ$$
「So maybe, just maybe, those guys
　could actually cure $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0021_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...$$ココナ$$, tell me the details.」

stage0021_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text: ～ $$マーティアル$$ Order HQ, Lord $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$' Office ～

stage0021_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...Good news.
　The 'Untouchable' has apparently been found.」

stage0021_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「We have people of the Order there too.
　I'll have them buy us some time.」

stage0021_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「You want me to go there too?」

stage0021_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「That's right.
　To show off your $$ネクスタント$$'s power,
　the 'Untouchable' is the perfect opponent.」

stage0021_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Go, $$テイタニア$$.
　Go and unleash that power to the fullest.」

stage0021_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
Montewells
「And offer up your victory
　to me... $$ヴィアチェスラフ・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$,
　none other.」

stage0021_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ココナ$$
「There you are, $$ＡＧ$$!
　This is the first time we've met like this!」

stage0021_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, Master $$ココナ$$.
　Master $$ゴウト$$ and Master $$バニラ$$ always
　help me out with stocking goods.」

stage0021_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Don't sweat it.
　You're an important customer to us, after all.」

stage0021_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「So, you making money, $$ＡＧ$$?
　I hear you've been collecting those
　weird things called Z-Chips.」

stage0021_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How rude, calling them weird...!
　Z-Chips hold infinite possibilities within them!」

stage0021_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Alright, alright.
　We're not interested in that side of it,
　so just pay us properly and we're fine.」

stage0021_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... how frustrating...!
　That I can't explain Z-Chips' wonder to you all...」

stage0021_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I too am a dimensional trader, however small.
　Still, I'll see my own trade through properly.」

stage0021_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Seeing you like that
　makes me want to work harder at stocking too.」

stage0021_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you, everyone.
　Now then, let's get fired up... business, business!」
